quote: indicated to reduce the risk of stroke in patients with hypertension and left ventricular hypertrophy
note: LVH is only the population in which stroke risk is reduced; the label never says losartan treats or regresses the hypertrophy.

quote: indicated to reduce LDL-C levels in boys and postmenarchal girls, 10 to 17 years of age, with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)
note: Lowering LDL-C is the treatment of HeFH itself (the disease is defined by elevated LDL-C), so the population phrasing does not make it a setting.

quote: indicated for the treatment of serious gynecological infections including endometritis
note: Endometritis is a named item in the list of indicated gynecological infections.

quote: indicated for the reduction of elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) in patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension
note: Ocular hypertension is elevated IOP, so reducing elevated IOP in ocular hypertension is treating the condition itself, not a background population; single-ingredient latanoprost labels carry it.

quote: Limited trials in pulmonary infections justify the use of flucytosine. Cryptococcus: Meningitis and pulmonary infections have been treated effectively.
note: The label only speaks of Candida/Cryptococcus pulmonary infections; 'recurrent pneumonia' as a clinical entity is never named and the recurrence qualifier has no support, so the mapping is spurious.

quote: indicated for adults and pediatric patients 2 years of age and older for the symptomatic treatment of: Seasonal and perennial allergic rhinitis
note: Allergic rhinitis is explicitly listed; symptomatic treatment of the disease still counts as management of it.

quote: patients with renal artery stenosis, chronic kidney disease, severe congestive heart failure, or volume depletion) may be at particular risk of developing acute renal failure on olmesartan medoxomil
note: Olmesartan is indicated only for hypertension; heart failure appears in the indications text solely as generic boilerplate about other antihypertensives and otherwise only in warnings as an at-risk population.

quote: EPKINLY is indicated in combination with lenalidomide and rituximab for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma (FL)
note: Relapsed/refractory FL is a subtype of follicular lymphoma and is explicitly indicated (also as monotherapy, and in the EMA text).

quote: indicated to improve survival of stable adult patients with symptomatic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (≤40%) (HFrEF) after an acute myocardial infarction (MI)
note: The thing treated is post-MI heart failure; the acute MI is a prior event defining the population, not a target of eplerenone.

quote: indicated as adjunctive therapy in edema associated with congestive heart failure, hepatic cirrhosis, and corticosteroid and estrogen therapy
note: Chlorothiazide treats the edema (a manifestation), not the cirrhosis that causes it; the edge swaps the symptom for the underlying disease.

quote: CIPRO ® HC OTIC is indicated for the treatment of acute otitis externa in adult and pediatric patients, one year and older, due to susceptible strains of Pseudomonas aeruginosa
note: Although the otic labels are combinations with a corticosteroid, the indication is a bacterial infection attributable to ciprofloxacin as the antibacterial component, so it belongs to this drug.

quote: It has been shown to be useful in the therapy of disseminated adenocarcinoma of the stomach or pancreas in proven combinations with other approved chemotherapeutic agents
note: Disseminated pancreatic adenocarcinoma is a subtype of pancreatic adenocarcinoma; combination and palliative use still count, and the 'not single-agent' caveat is not a negation of the indication.

quote: KESIMPTA is indicated for the treatment of relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (MS)
note: Relapsing MS is a near-child of multiple sclerosis that essentially describes what is indicated, so the parent edge is not misleadingly broad.

quote: Apply an appropriate amount to the palm of your hand or bathing utensil with water to form a lather and gently lather over the body, then rinse off with water.
note: The only supplied text is directions for a body wash, a different product entirely with no indication at all, so cough cannot be judged.

quote: Actinomycosis (cervicofacial disease and thoracic and abdominal disease) Actinomyces Israelil
note: Actinomycosis is a named clinical indication in the penicillin G indications table.
The multivitamin/fluoride texts cover only dietary supplementation and caries prophylaxis; fever or any febrile disorder is not mentioned anywhere.

quote: ASMANEX ® TWISTHALER ® is indicated for the maintenance treatment of asthma as prophylactic therapy in adult and pediatric patients 4 years of age and older
note: Single-ingredient mometasone inhalers are indicated for asthma, so the combination DULERA label is not needed; the acute-bronchospasm limitation does not negate the maintenance indication.

quote: postencephalitic parkinsonism, and symptomatic parkinsonism, which may follow injury to the nervous system by carbon monoxide intoxication and/or manganese intoxication
note: What is treated is the parkinsonism; carbon monoxide intoxication is only the antecedent cause of the patient's condition, not something carbidopa treats.

quote: Amversio is indicated as adjunctive treatment of homocystinuria, involving deficiencies or defects in: cystathionine beta-synthase (CBS)
note: Homocystinuria is named directly as the treated disease in the EMA text; adjunctive use counts.

quote: indicated to increase systemic exposure of atazanavir or darunavir (once daily dosing regimen) in combination with other antiretroviral agents in the treatment of HIV-1 infection
note: The edge's disease is an unresolved UMLS code with no name, so it cannot be matched against the text (which concerns HIV-1 infection, where cobicistat acts as a pharmacokinetic booster).

quote: adult and paediatric patients with newly diagnosed Philadelphia chromosome positive chronic myelogenous leukaemia (CML) in the chronic phase
note: Ph+ chronic-phase CML is a subtype of chronic myeloid leukemia explicitly indicated in the EMA text; the blast-crisis caveat is a data gap, not a negation of CML.

quote: Reduction of elevated intraocular pressure in chronic open-angle glaucoma and ocular hypertension (as monotherapy or as adjunctive therapy to beta-blockers)
note: IOP reduction is the management of open-angle glaucoma itself (like treating the pain of osteoarthritis), so glaucoma is the target rather than a background population.

quote: indicated for the complete or partial reversal of opioid drug effects, including respiratory depression, induced by either natural or synthetic opioids
note: Opioid-induced respiratory depression is a form of hypoventilation and the injection label names its reversal directly as the indication, not merely as a manifestation of overdose.

quote: or greater than or equal to 27 kg/m 2 in the presence of other risk factors (e.g., controlled hypertension, diabetes, hyperlipidemia)
note: Phentermine is indicated for obesity; diabetes appears only as a comorbid risk factor that defines the eligible population, and in warnings about adjusting antidiabetic drugs.

quote: Treatment of multiple myeloma.
note: Plasma cell myeloma is an exact synonym of multiple myeloma, which the EMA text names as a treated disease.

quote: RITUXAN, in combination with methotrexate, is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with moderately- to severely-active rheumatoid arthritis
note: Rheumatoid arthritis is explicitly indicated in both FDA and EMA texts; combination with methotrexate still counts.

quote: Xenleta is indicated for the treatment of community-acquired pneumonia (CAP) in adults
note: The EMA text names community-acquired pneumonia directly as the treated disease.

quote: Juvenile idiopathic arthritis Treatment of polyarthritis (rheumatoid factor positive or negative) and extended oligoarthritis in children and adolescents from the age of 2 years
note: Polyarthritis (polyarticular JIA) is explicitly indicated and is a specific form of polyarticular arthritis; the edge is a near parent that still describes what is indicated.

quote: Alprazolam extended-release tablets are indicated for the treatment of panic disorder with or without agoraphobia, in adults.
note: Panic disorder is named directly as the treated condition.

quote: Heart failure Jardiance is indicated in adults for the treatment of symptomatic chronic heart failure.
note: Congestive heart failure is the standard synonym for heart failure and symptomatic chronic heart failure is a form of it, named as the treated disease in the EMA text.

quote: Uses for hand washing to decrease bacteria on the skin.
note: The triclosan texts are hand-soap labels about reducing skin bacteria; dental caries or teeth are never mentioned.

quote: prolong the time to recurrence of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation/flutter (PAF) associated with disabling symptoms in patients without structural heart disease
note: Paroxysmal/episodic AF is a subtype of atrial fibrillation explicitly indicated; the 'not evaluated' statements for permanent AF and the rate-control caveat limit but do not negate the AF indication.

quote: to temporarily maintain the patency of the ductus arteriosus until corrective or palliative surgery can be performed in neonates who have congenital heart defects
note: Alprostadil keeps the ductus open; pulmonary stenosis is listed only as one of the congenital defects defining the neonates in whom this supportive bridge therapy is used.

quote: Kinpeygo is indicated for the treatment of adults with primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN)
note: IgA nephropathy is the standard synonym for IgA glomerulonephritis and is named directly as the treated disease.

quote: reducing neurologic disability and/or the frequency of clinical relapses in patients with secondary (chronic) progressive, progressive relapsing, or worsening relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis
note: Several MS subtypes are explicitly indicated; the explicit exclusion of primary progressive MS narrows but does not negate multiple sclerosis as a target.

quote: For the management of primary dysmenorrhea
note: Primary dysmenorrhea is a subtype of dysmenorrhea named directly as managed by naproxen.

quote: maintenance treatment of bronchospasm associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), including chronic bronchitis and emphysema
note: Chronic bronchitis is a named component of the indicated COPD; treating the disease's bronchospasm is management of the disease (as with pain of osteoarthritis), so it is not a symptom swap.

quote: In addition to the above indications, prednisone tablets are indicated for systemic dermatomyositis (polymyositis).
note: Dermatomyositis is named directly as an indicated collagen disease on prednisone labels.
